title: EED-RR: code, data and results for "Round Robin scheduling with an elastic time quantum regulated by Jain's fairness index and per-process deficit"
description:
Code, input data, raw results and generated paper assets for the study EED-RR: Round Robin scheduling with an elastic time quantum regulated by Jain's fairness index and per-process deficit (submitted to PLOS ONE).

The repository contains an event-driven single-CPU scheduling simulator; implementations of EED-RR, fixed-quantum Round Robin, MARR, EImHLVQTRR, ADRR (interpretation), SARR, STS-RR, FCFS, SJF and SRTF, equal-budget and random-boost controls, and ablations; a test suite (textbook oracles, worked examples, a published MARR example, and exact reproduction of the earlier version's results); the experiment design (2,520 workload instances: Poisson synthetic workloads with five burst distributions, four loads and three process counts; overloaded batch workloads; the original Kaggle-derived dataset; 60 windows of the SDSC-SP2 trace; a switch-cost scenario); paired statistics; the archived raw per-instance results; and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the paper. The complete study was reproduced bit-for-bit on two platforms.

Data licences. The code is MIT-licensed. data/SDSC-SP2-1998-4.2-cln.swf.gz is redistributed unmodified from the Parallel Workloads Archive under its own terms (research and non-profit use, copyright notice preserved in the file header); please cite Feitelson DG, Tsafrir D, Krakov D, J Parallel Distrib Comput 2014;74(10):2967-2982. data/process_data.csv was generated from the Kaggle dataset "CPU Process Workload Dataset" (bhaikko).
